t: You're looking at 22 Endell Street, a Grade II listed building that was once the headquarters of Lavers and Barraud. It was designed by Robert Jewell Withers, an English architect who specialised in churches. It also carries work by Sir Brian Clarke, the British painter and architectural artist best known for his large-scale stained glass and mosaic projects. Clarke made his contribution here, so the building brings together a Victorian ecclesiastical architect and a major stained glass artist of our own time.
